name: org.mssid.mishkat/lectures
title: Mishkat (مِشكاة) Arabic Islamic lectures
description: Arabic Islamic lectures and verbatim benefits with timestamped sources, and a guide to cut reels.

tools.name: search_lectures
tools.description: Find the passages of the lectures where the scholar speaks about a subject or answers a question. Returns verbatim passages (his words as transcribed), grouped by lecture, each with a timestamped link. Arabic queries work best. Use this first for any question about what the scholar says.

query.description: the subject or question, preferably in Arabic

tools.name: search_treasures
tools.description: Search the curated treasures (kunuz): short verbatim spans picked from the lectures and classified. wassaya = advices; memorable_quotes = memorable sayings of the scholar; hadith_fawaid = benefits drawn from a hadith; tafsir_fawaid = benefits from a verse; sira_ibrah = lessons from the Sira and history; imam_sayings = sayings of earlier scholars he quotes; glad_tidings = glad tidings; diagnostic_observations = diagnoses of the Ummah's problems; qa_pairs = questions and answers; books_recommended = books he recommends. Matches the verbatim text (Arabic).

tools.name: browse_treasures
tools.description: List treasures of one type, optionally from one lecture or one channel, newest lectures first, with paging. wassaya = advices; memorable_quotes = memorable sayings of the scholar; hadith_fawaid = benefits drawn from a hadith; tafsir_fawaid = benefits from a verse; sira_ibrah = lessons from the Sira and history; imam_sayings = sayings of earlier scholars he quotes; glad_tidings = glad tidings; diagnostic_observations = diagnoses of the Ummah's problems; qa_pairs = questions and answers; books_recommended = books he recommends

tools.name: get_treasure
tools.description: One treasure in full: its verbatim text, the explanation fields (summaries, not quotations), the exact segment range in its lecture and a timestamped link.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: The YouTube channels in the corpus, with how many lectures each has.

tools.name: list_lectures
tools.description: Lectures in the corpus (with a transcript), optionally of one channel or whose title contains some words, newest first.

tools.name: get_lecture
tools.description: A lecture's details: title, channel, length, series it belongs to, its topics with their summaries, and how many treasures of each type it holds. Use get_transcript for its words.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: The lecture's words in order, as numbered segments with start/end seconds (paged). Machine transcription, corrected in places. Use segment numbers from other results to read the context around a passage.

tools.name: find_verse_discussions
tools.description: Where in the lectures a Quran verse is recited or explained, with the verse's mushaf text (Hafs) and the tafsir benefits drawn from it.

tools.name: search_topics
tools.description: Search the topic map built over all lectures (Arabic or English topic titles); returns topic ids for get_topic.

tools.name: get_topic
tools.description: A topic of the map with the lecture passages filed under it (each with its summary, lecture and link).

tools.name: reel_guide
tools.description: The guide for cutting a short vertical reel (Reels, Shorts, TikTok) from these lectures with your own tools: what is needed (yt-dlp, ffmpeg, Arabic and Quran fonts), how to choose the passage, cut on whole sentences, caption with his exact words, show Quran verses from the mushaf, the sharia rules every clip keeps, framing, attribution with the timestamped link, and a checklist. Read it before making any clip.

tools.name: get_passage_words
tools.description: Every word of a stretch of a lecture (at most 180 seconds) with its start and end second in the lecture, the segment it belongs to, and whether the timing was measured from the audio or estimated. Use it to place a reel's cut on word boundaries and to time its captions. The words are the corrected transcript, his words.
